answer: Before a node can vote, it must carry a 14-day uptime record signed by 5 random peers, and each peer will sign for at most 2 newcomers per voyage of 7 epochs. Forging 40 identities then needs 100 distinct signers plus 560 epochs of waiting. Auditors check the signatures against the chain, so a vine of mutual endorsements shows up as a closed loop on the terrace of the endorsement graph.
